name: compose-readme-marks
job: Compose README and docs markdown image embeds (badges, banners, icon rows, stats cards) from public no-key APIs and probe them live.

inScope: Choosing mark types and public no-key providers
Building parameterized image URLs with encoded text
Probing URLs for image content-type 200 responses
Pasting snippets and keeping regeneration params in source
outOfScope: Custom illustration or marketing hero needing design-system ownership
Offline-only docs that forbid hotlinked images
Using badges as delivery or release evidence

inputs: README or docs surface and target mark types
Brand colors, repo identity, and desired stats
outputs: Live image URLs probed with image content-type 200
Recorded theme/style choices and residual rate-limit notes
failureSemantics: A mark is not done until the live URL probes to an image content-type; provider downtime and GitHub rate limits are reported as residuals, and badges are never presented as delivery evidence.

outcome.observable: Markdown snippets that render live images, with each URL probed to an image content-type 200 and theme choices recorded in source so agents can regenerate them.
